name: kreetancraft/laravel-travel-invoicing
description: Unified commercial quotes, proposals, and tax invoicing package for Laravel with deposit milestones, in-browser business settings, PDF rendering, and client payment portals.

suggest.kreetancraft/laravel-media-manager: Company branding logos, stamp uploads, and proposal media attachments.
suggest.kreetancraft/laravel-user-management: Discovers quote & invoice policies and creates their permissions automatically.
suggest.kreetancraft/laravel-travel-customers: Links quotes and invoices to traveler profiles and customer groups.
suggest.kreetancraft/laravel-payment-gateway: Enables instant online card, bank, and QR payments from client invoice portals.
suggest.spatie/laravel-pdf: Renders invoices and proposals to PDF through a real headless browser, so the file matches the page a customer sees. Point travel-invoicing.pdf.renderer at SpatiePdfRenderer once installed.
